candidate_merges.message: Temporarily disable source indexing in official builds (#20622) ## Description Temporarily skip the standalone `source_index` stage so the source-index publishing access failure does not mark otherwise successful official builds as failed. The Azure CLI task currently fails while selecting its configured subscription, before the index upload script runs. Adds `condition: 'false'` to the stage and a comment directly above it linking to #20621, which tracks restoring access and re-enabling source
